field_principles.cross_family_ci95: Task-level bootstrap CI95 of the cross-family delta -- excluding 0 means the verifier generalizes to unseen families.
field_principles.cross_family_delta: BARE float: set_encoder@1 - vote@1 on HELD-OUT FAMILIES -- the load-bearing OOD lift (compare to the within-pool +0.4423).
field_principles.cross_family_win_holds: BARE bool: the capstone reads this as the OOD verdict (gated-fields-must-be-bare); true iff the held-out-family set_encoder@1 - vote@1 > 0 AND CI95-excl-0 -- the real generalization signal.
field_principles.held_out_family_n: BARE int: number of families never seen in training -- the OOD breadth; report with held_out_task_n for power.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A cross-family win, a within-pool-only collapse, and a no-headroom are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade.
field_principles.model_specs: The family-disjoint split protocol + set-encoder config + online-adapt rule; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adapt_cross_family_delta: The online-reweighted selector's cross-family delta -- the static-vs-adaptive self-learning comparison (deepened in A4).
field_principles.oracle_at_k: Positive-control ceiling on held-out families -- if ~=vote the cross-family null is uninformative, not a verifier failure.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the family-split + bootstrap reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the pool + family partition + manifest; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned set-encoder, no demo execution; keeps the transfer result oracle-distinct.
field_principles.within_minus_cross_gap: The within-pool +0.4423 minus cross_family_delta -- quantifies how much of the win was per-family-basin memorization.

online_adapt_rule.feedback: prior held-out task exact-match labels only; current task ranking uses no current correctness

set_encoder_config.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
set_encoder_config.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
set_encoder_config.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
set_encoder_config.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.
